summary: Enerflex Ltd. (TSX: EFX; NYSE: EFXT), a Calgary-based industrial machinery company, disclosed via Form 6-K that it has completed the sale of the majority of its Asia Pacific operations to INNIO Group. The divested business, focused on After-Market Services, sharpens Enerflex's focus on North America, Latin America, and the Middle East. No deal price, premium, or financial terms were disclosed. The company also confirmed Q3 2026 results timing and a related investor call. The transaction removes APAC AMS revenue, so watch for pro forma leverage and EPS accretion commentary on the October 29 call.
